en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large wooden building with towers and flags on a rocky island, seen from the water. The structure stands prominently on the small island with sparse vegetation and low shoreline. Printed captions appear in the sky area: at upper left, the word 'Klippan.' and at upper right, the tripartite name of the city in Swedish, Finnish, and Russian alphabets.
